# CyberLeninka

> > CyberLeninka is Russia's leading open-access digital repository of peer-reviewed scientific articles across all major academic disciplines.

CyberLeninka aggregates and indexes Russian scientific publications from peer-reviewed journals, making research freely accessible to global audiences. The platform covers fundamental and applied sciences, medicine, engineering, and emerging technologies, with content indexed in international databases like Scopus and Web of Science.

## Key Topics

- Open Science Infrastructure
- Peer-Reviewed Articles
- Academic Database
- Russian Research
- Scientific Publications
- VAK (Higher Attestation Commission)
- Scopus Indexing
- ESCI (Emerging Sources Citation Index)
- RSCI (Russian Science Citation Index)
- Open Access
- Scientific Repositories
- Medical Research
- Engineering Sciences
- Biotechnology

## Open Science Infrastructure & Development

- [Возможные пути развития открытой науки в России](https://cyberleninka.ru/article/n/vozmozhnye-puti-razvitiya-otkrytoy-nauki-v-rossii): Open science development pathways in Russia: repositories, journals, and CyberLeninka implementation
- [Инфраструктура открытой науки](https://cyberleninka.ru/article/n/infrastruktura-otkrytoy-nauki): Open Science Infrastructure trends and development for researchers, government, and society
